The structure of Tm2Hg2Bi2 (reduced formula TmHgBi) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows each Bi and Hg center has eight Tm neighbors, and each Tm center has four Bi and four Hg neighbors, all at 3.2894 Å, forming a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 8-vertex Bi, Hg, and Tm coordination polyhedra.
